headline: Strong Buy consensus, but a rich valuation
chart_note: 52-week range: $77.99 - $110.51. Currently $99.27, about 10% below its high.
why_today: Starbucks trades just 10% below its 52-week high with a strong Buy-leaning analyst consensus (16 Buy vs 3 Sell) and a price target implying further upside - but a PE north of 60x, roughly double its 10-year median, is priced for a lot of turnaround success to go right.
pro_1: 16 of 19 analysts covering the stock rate it a Buy, with an average price target of $112.23 implying further upside
pro_2: Only about 10% below its 52-week high shows real investor confidence in the ongoing turnaround
con_1: PE of roughly 61.7x is about double its 10-year median - a lot of good news is already priced in
con_2: Any stumble in the turnaround story could hit the stock hard given how much premium is baked into the valuation
